title: Recover protected auth-mail runtime from the existing REG.RU access mailbox
acceptance: use only the existing REG.RU SMTP authority for access@процент-агро.рф
accept current or legacy protected secret aliases without publishing values
fail before SSH when no protected SMTP password is available
authenticate with implicit TLS on sm38.hosting.reg.ru:465 and send no message during the credential probe
require pinned REG.RU production SSH identity before any runtime file mutation
reuse scripts/provision-production-p0-password-reset-runtime.sh rather than duplicating delivery-key generation or validation
allow only root-owned mode-0600 auth-mail runtime files in the active Compose working directory
perform no database or deployment mutation
publish only bounded readiness markers and never paths, credentials, raw environment values or raw SMTP responses
